requirements.title: Approved technology stack alignment
requirements.requirement_summary: Validate UCM Daily Register against the approved stack, including FastAPI, React/Vite/TypeScript, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy/Alembic, Python and JavaScript tooling, testing, CI/CD, GitOps, source control, auth, secrets, observability, and AI gateway/model choices.

current_assertion.summary: FastAPI/Uvicorn, React/Vite/TypeScript, SQLAlchemy/Alembic, pytest, Vitest, Compose and GitHub Actions are present. Entra OIDC is implemented alongside header mode. Approved deployment tooling, secrets integration, full observability and model/gateway decisions remain unverified.

current_assertion.summary: Entra confidential-client OIDC, claim/Graph role mapping, signed app sessions and authorization tests are implemented. Header prototype mode remains the default. Live enablement, registration/consent, role assignments and institutional approval require per-environment evidence; no production alignment is asserted.
